accessibility_menu_failure.minimal_gtk_app_source:
import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
gi.require_version('Adw', '1')
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
app = Adw.Application(application_id='com.flowmux.Test.PlainMenu')
def activate(app):
    window = Adw.ApplicationWindow(application=app, default_width=800, default_height=600)
    box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL)
    menu = Gtk.MenuButton(label='Plain actions')
    popover = Gtk.Popover()
    button = Gtk.Button(label='Destination')
    def choose(button):
        popover.popdown()
        dialog = Adw.AlertDialog(heading='Destination picker')
        dialog.set_extra_child(Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Pane', 'New workspace']))
        dialog.add_response('cancel', 'Cancel')
        dialog.present(window)
    button.connect('clicked', choose)
    popover.set_child(button)
    menu.set_popover(popover)
    box.append(menu)
    window.set_content(box)
    window.maximize()
    window.present()
app.connect('activate', activate)
app.run(None)
